answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design fully addresses this scenario. Gap 11 in the Context/gaps section explicitly names the problem: in combined `--resume --from-stage <s>` mode, clearing `skip_until_stage` without also clearing `resume_mode` leaves the resume skip guard (`$resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]`) active for all subsequent units, silently skipping any that are marked complete. The Decision paragraph contains the exact fix: in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:\* and stage:\*) inside `main()` in runner.sh, immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`, also set `resume_mode=false` — pure resume runs never set `skip_until_stage` so this change is unreachable for them. DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior: a 3-unit fixture `[intake, cyc, verify]` with all three marked complete, invoked with `--resume --from-stage cyc`, must emit stage.start for `verify` — the test fails on old code (verify skipped) and passes after the fix. This is documented in Gap 11, Findings 30 and 31, the Decision paragraph, and the DSFSTG-3 SPEC. No design change is required.
